title: gynostemma pentaphyllum
intro: Gynostemma pentaphyllum, commonly known as Jiaogulan, is a perennial vine native to Asia, belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Jiaogulan include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Jiaogulan include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
